_source: Recorded-shape fixtures from TinyFish's official https://docs.tinyfish.ai/api-reference/search-the-web and https://docs.tinyfish.ai/search-api/reference (read 2026-10-20). Success follows the documented query/results/total_results/page envelope and title/url/snippet item example; the second item and optional date are illustrative. Standard error objects follow the documented schema; values and Retry-After are illustrative, not captured authenticated replies. 422 and quota-bearing 403 are shared-classifier probes, not documented TinyFish error meanings. Local transport states (timeout, NotSent, OutcomeUnknown, missing body) are tested separately. Capability skip exceeds the documented query-length bound; public tool validation currently has a narrower envelope.
